dialogue.origin: こんにちは相談員ですよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm the counselor. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは
dialogue.content: Hello.

dialogue.origin: 今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.content: How can I help you today?

dialogue.origin: 将来の仕事のことで決断ができなくて、、、
dialogue.content: I'm having trouble making a decision about my future career...

dialogue.origin: 将来のお仕事のことですね
dialogue.content: I see, it's about your future career.

dialogue.origin: 決断というのは具体的にどのような？
dialogue.content: What kind of decision is it, specifically?

dialogue.origin: 実は独立開業したいのです
dialogue.content: Actually, I want to start my own business.

dialogue.origin: でも勇気が、、
dialogue.content: But I don't have the courage...

dialogue.origin: 独立なさりたい気持ちがおありなのですね
dialogue.content: So you have the desire to start your own business.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 独立ともなると勇気は非常にいる事ですよね
dialogue.content: Starting your own business certainly takes a lot of courage, doesn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 独立なさりたい業種は経験あるお仕事内容ですか？
dialogue.content: Is the industry you want to start in one where you have experience?

dialogue.origin: いえ、まったく初めての分野です
dialogue.content: No, it's a completely new field for me.

dialogue.origin: 初めての試みなのですね
dialogue.content: So it's your first time trying this.

dialogue.origin: そうなんです
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: それはとっても慎重になりますよね
dialogue.content: That would make anyone very cautious, wouldn't it?

dialogue.origin: はい、まさに、、
dialogue.content: Yes, exactly...

dialogue.origin: その業種をはじめたいお気持ちはいつ頃からですか？
dialogue.content: How long have you wanted to start a business in that industry?

dialogue.origin: 独立は社会人になる前からの夢でした。この業界に注目したのは最近興味がわいてきたからです、数ヵ月くらい前からです
dialogue.content: Starting my own business has been a dream of mine since before I started working. I only became interested in this particular industry recently, about a few months ago.

dialogue.origin: 社会人になられる前からなのですね
dialogue.content: So it's been a dream since before you entered the workforce.

dialogue.origin: 夢です
dialogue.content: It’s my dream.

dialogue.origin: この数か月で独立にむけて具体的な事は何かなされましたか？
dialogue.content: In these past few months, have you taken any concrete steps toward starting your own business?

dialogue.origin: 勉強はしてきました資金について考えたりや業界の方ともお会いして取引について相談したりもしています
dialogue.content: I've been studying, thinking about funding, and I've also met with people in the industry to discuss business deals.

dialogue.origin: 会社のCIについても自分の中では少しずつ固まってきているかなと思っています
dialogue.content: I feel that the company’s corporate identity is also gradually taking shape in my mind.

dialogue.origin: おお！！夢がまさしく実現に向けて手が届きそうな感じですね
dialogue.content: Wow! It sounds like your dream is really within reach.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: 具体的に考え実際に行動まで移されていらっしゃる
dialogue.content: You've thought about it concretely and have actually started taking action.

dialogue.origin: 一応ですが、、はい
dialogue.content: Well, to some extent... yes.

dialogue.origin: 後は、どんなことが不安の材料でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Aside from that, what else is contributing to your anxiety?

dialogue.origin: やはり、成功するかどうか…と思うと怖いです
dialogue.content: I guess I'm scared when I think about whether I'll succeed or not...

dialogue.origin: 周りにも起業した知人は何人もいますが、1年もたたずに撤退して借金だけ残っていたりするのを見ているので。。
dialogue.content: I have several acquaintances who started their own businesses, but I've seen them fail in less than a year, left with only debt...

dialogue.origin: 初めての試み、しかも成功するか。と言うのは怖い思いは大きいですよね
dialogue.content: Trying something for the first time, and wondering if you'll succeed... that's a very big fear, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: また、成功するまで諦めずにずっと借金を重ねている知人もいます。それも怖いです
dialogue.content: I also have acquaintances who keep taking on debt without giving up until they succeed. That’s scary too.

dialogue.origin: 借金となると恐怖になりますよね
dialogue.content: The thought of debt can be terrifying, can't it?

dialogue.origin: もちろん、成功が約束された起業なんて存在しないことは分かっているのですが、、
dialogue.content: Of course, I know that there's no such thing as a startup that's guaranteed to succeed, but...

dialogue.origin: 借金は怖いです、不況だし、、
dialogue.content: Debt is scary, and the economy is in a slump...

dialogue.origin: 設備投資にある程度初期費用がかかるので、最初は僕も借金からのスタートなんです
dialogue.content: It requires some initial capital for equipment, so I’d be starting out in debt as well.

dialogue.origin: まして知人の方の例をまじかでみてらっしゃる訳ですもの怖いですよね
dialogue.content: Especially since you've seen what happened to your acquaintances up close, it must be frightening.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 色々と行動はなされていらっしゃるようですが他にはどこかにご相談されたりしてますか？
dialogue.content: It sounds like you've been taking various actions. Have you consulted with anyone else?

dialogue.origin: 銀行とか、一応
dialogue.content: Like the bank, sort of.

dialogue.origin: あとは友人にも
dialogue.content: And my friends, too.

dialogue.origin: お金からみだと銀行は必須ですよね
dialogue.content: When it comes to money, the bank is essential, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: ローンはおそらく組めそうな感じなんです
dialogue.content: It seems like I can probably get a loan.

dialogue.origin: ただ個人経営なので途中解約が難しくて、失敗してもやはり借金は残るパターンです。。。
dialogue.content: But since it's a sole proprietorship, it's hard to cancel midway, so if I fail, I'll still be left with the debt...

dialogue.origin: 知人の方にもご相談され、銀行でもローンは組めそうなのですね
dialogue.content: So you've talked to your acquaintances, and it seems you can get a loan from the bank.

dialogue.origin: とりあえず、そんな感じですが…
dialogue.content: For now, that's the situation, but...

dialogue.origin: 思いきれなくて
dialogue.content: I just can’t take the plunge.

dialogue.origin: 大きな金額から始める事業なのですか？
dialogue.content: Is it a business that requires a large amount of capital to start?

dialogue.origin: いえ、数百万ほどですが、僕にとっては大変な金額です、、！
dialogue.content: No, it's several million yen, but to me, that's a huge amount of money...!

dialogue.origin: 数百万ともなれば大きいですよね
dialogue.content: Several million yen is certainly a lot.

dialogue.origin: はいお金のことを思うと、やはり無難に他の会社に就職したほうがいいのかなあとも思ったりします
dialogue.content: Yes... When I think about the money, I sometimes wonder if it would be safer to just get a job at another company.

dialogue.origin: 成功しなかった時の事、借金を背負うかもしれない事、初めてのチャレンジ不安だらけで怖い思いは拭えないですね
dialogue.content: The thought of not succeeding, of possibly being burdened with debt, and the anxiety of a new challenge... it's hard to shake off that fear, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That’s right.

dialogue.origin: 怖いです
dialogue.content: I’m scared.

dialogue.origin: でも、社会人前からの夢を今、叶えようと動きはじめていらっしゃる
dialogue.content: But you’re now taking steps to realize a dream you’ve had since before you started working.

dialogue.origin: ちょうど今、転機もあったので
dialogue.content: I’ve just had a turning point recently.

dialogue.origin: 転機！タイミングはとても大事な要素ですよね
dialogue.content: A turning point! Timing is a very important factor, isn't it?

dialogue.origin: そう、ですかねえ、、
dialogue.content: I guess so...

dialogue.origin: うーん、悩みます
dialogue.content: Hmm, I'm torn.

dialogue.origin: 開業か、就職か、という分岐点です
dialogue.content: I’m at a crossroads: start a business or get a job.

dialogue.origin: 悩まれて当然の事を今チャレンジしようと。でも無難に就職も片隅にはあるのですね
dialogue.content: It's completely natural to be torn about the challenge you're about to take on. But the safer option of getting a job is still in the back of your mind.

dialogue.origin: 心配している友人もいますし、独立とか無理じゃねー？とか言われると、やっぱ無理かなあとか、、弱気になります
dialogue.content: I have friends who are worried about me, and when they say things like, “Isn’t going independent impossible?” I start thinking maybe it is... it makes me lose confidence.

dialogue.origin: 就職なら少なくとも借金にはなりませんから
dialogue.content: At least with a job, I won't end up in debt.

dialogue.origin: 心配なさって下さるご友人もいらっしゃる反面、ご自身でも納得されるお気持ちもあおりなのですね
dialogue.content: So you have friends who worry about you, and what they say also stirs up your own feelings of doubt.

dialogue.origin: 難しいだろうとは思っています、簡単なわけはないので
dialogue.content: I do think it will be difficult; I know it won't be easy.

dialogue.origin: 起業する事とお金の不安だとどちらが比重が高いですか？
dialogue.content: Between starting a business itself and the financial worries, which weighs more heavily for you?

dialogue.origin: 比重と言うと？
dialogue.content: Weighs more heavily?

dialogue.origin: 初めてのチャレンジの怖さとお金の怖さですかね
dialogue.content: I mean the fear of this new challenge versus the fear of the financial aspect.

dialogue.origin: 初めてのことはそれなりに楽しみです
dialogue.content: I’m actually somewhat excited about doing something new.

dialogue.origin: それは素敵なことですよね
dialogue.content: That’s wonderful.

dialogue.origin: 初めてだから失敗するかも、と思っているわけではありません
dialogue.content: It's not that I think I'll fail just because it's my first time.

dialogue.origin: ええ
dialogue.content: I see.

dialogue.origin: よく知っている分野でも失敗することはあると思いますし
dialogue.content: I think it's possible to fail even in a field you know well.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね
dialogue.content: That’s true.

dialogue.origin: 分野とか業界への不安というよりも、やはりお金ですかね
dialogue.content: So rather than anxiety about the field or industry, it's really about the money.

dialogue.origin: 起業そのものへの不安という感じです
dialogue.content: It's more like an anxiety about the act of starting a business itself.

dialogue.origin: 自分に代表が務まるのかとか
dialogue.content: Like whether I can really be the head of a company.

dialogue.origin: 集客とか
dialogue.content: Or attracting customers.

dialogue.origin: どの業界であっても悩みは同じだと思います
dialogue.content: I think the worries would be the same in any industry.

dialogue.origin: お金、借金する事になるのも責任の大きさににも不安が拭えない感じなのですね
dialogue.content: So it seems the anxiety about money, taking on debt, and the weight of responsibility is something you can't shake off.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: しかも友人にも心配されるし…
dialogue.content: And on top of that, my friends are worried about me...

dialogue.origin: ご友人の他にはどんな所に相談されましたか？
dialogue.content: Aside from your friends, where else have you sought advice?

dialogue.origin: 家族には言っていません今の会社にも秘密にしています
dialogue.content: I haven't told my family. I'm keeping it a secret from my current company as well.

dialogue.origin: ご家族にも会社の方ににもお話しは出来ていらっしゃらないのですね
dialogue.content: So you haven’t been able to talk about it with your family or anyone at your company.

dialogue.origin: はい、家族には心配されるだけでしょうし
dialogue.content: Yes, my family would just worry.

dialogue.origin: 今の会社には言っても仕方がないと思うので
dialogue.content: And I don't think there's any point in telling my current company.

dialogue.origin: 起業と就職と現在、分岐点とおっしゃっておられましたが
dialogue.content: You mentioned you're at a crossroads between starting a business and getting a job.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今は、どちらか少しでも気持ちが大きいのはどちらですか？
dialogue.content: At this moment, even slightly, which way are you leaning?

dialogue.origin: それが分からないので悩んでいます
dialogue.content: That's what I don't know, which is why I'm struggling.

dialogue.origin: 半々な感じなのですね
dialogue.content: So you feel it's about 50-50.

dialogue.origin: でもまた就職するのはつまらないなという気は少ししています
dialogue.content: But I do have a feeling that just getting another job would be boring.

dialogue.origin: 就職はつまらない。とも感じられるのですね
dialogue.content: So you also feel that getting a job would be boring.

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: That's right.

dialogue.origin: やはり独立は夢なので
dialogue.content: After all, starting my own business is my dream.

dialogue.origin: 夢を諦めたくない気持ちは大きそうですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like your desire not to give up on your dream is very strong.

dialogue.origin: 諦めたくはないです
dialogue.content: I don’t want to give up.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね！
dialogue.content: I understand!

dialogue.origin: いつかは、とは思っています
dialogue.content: I do think I want to do it someday.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 今かどうかはやはり悩みますが…
dialogue.content: But I'm still struggling with whether now is the time...

dialogue.origin: 最初に申し上げた通り、勇気が出ないんです
dialogue.content: As I said at the beginning, I just can't find the courage.

dialogue.origin: 起業に向けて専門家の方に相談はしてみる気はおありですか？
dialogue.content: Would you be willing to consult with a specialist about starting a business?

dialogue.origin: 起業コンサルタントとかそういう系ですか？
dialogue.content: Do you mean a startup consultant or something like that?

dialogue.origin: そうですね中小企業診断士とか
dialogue.content: Yes, like a small business consultant.

dialogue.origin: あまり初期投資を増やしたくない気持ちはありますが…
dialogue.content: I'd rather not increase my initial investment, but...

dialogue.origin: どうなんでしょうか、やはり聞いたほうがいいのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What do you think? Should I seek their advice?

dialogue.origin: そうですね
dialogue.content: I think so.

dialogue.origin: 具体的にどこが不安かという所が明確になれば進みたい気持ちもはっきりされるかと
dialogue.content: If you can clarify exactly what you're anxious about, your desire to move forward might become clearer as well.

dialogue.origin: 具体的にはお金なので、そこら辺の専門性のある方がいいのかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: Specifically, it’s the money, so perhaps someone with expertise in that area would be good.

dialogue.origin: もちろん他にも不安はありますが、1番はお金なので、、
dialogue.content: Of course I have other concerns, but the biggest one is the money...

dialogue.origin: お金をかけなくても無料で相談にのってもらえれば気持ちも楽ですよね
dialogue.content: It would be a relief if you could get a consultation for free without spending more money, right?

dialogue.origin: そういう相談所みたいなところもあるんですか？
dialogue.content: Are there places like consultation centers that offer that?

dialogue.origin: はい、ありますよ一度詳しくお調べになってみて頂ければ少しは気持ちも楽になるかと
dialogue.content: Yes, there are. If you look into it in detail, I think you might feel a little more at ease.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、調べてみようかな
dialogue.content: You're right, maybe I'll look into it.

dialogue.origin: ええ！是非調べてみて下さい
dialogue.content: Yes! Please do look into it.

dialogue.origin: 確かにプロの意見はあったほうが良さそうですね
dialogue.content: It certainly seems like getting a professional's opinion would be helpful.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: そうですね、餅屋は餅屋といいますね笑
dialogue.content: That's right. As they say, 'leave it to the experts.' (laughs)

dialogue.origin: 探してみます！
dialogue.content: I’ll look for one!

dialogue.origin: 私もワクワクしてきました！！
dialogue.content: I’m getting excited too!

dialogue.origin: 光栄です
dialogue.content: I’m honored.

dialogue.origin: ちょっと自信なくなりかけていたので
dialogue.content: I was starting to lose a bit of confidence.

dialogue.origin: はい、前向きにトライしてみて頂ければ嬉しいです
dialogue.content: Yes, I'd be happy if you could try to move forward with a positive outlook.

dialogue.origin: 分かりました、もう少し動いてみます
dialogue.content: Understood. I’ll take a few more steps.

dialogue.origin: はい、夢を叶える為にも頑張ってみて下さい！
dialogue.content: Yes, please do your best to make your dream come true!

dialogue.origin: はい！
dialogue.content: I will!

dialogue.origin: 以上となりますが、何か言い足りない事などありますか？
dialogue.content: That brings us to the end. Is there anything we haven’t covered or anything you’d like to add?

dialogue.origin: とりあえず今は大丈夫です
dialogue.content: I think I'm okay for now.

dialogue.origin: 次にやることが決まったので
dialogue.content: I’ve decided on my next steps.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Thank you.

dialogue.origin: そうですか良かったです！
dialogue.content: I see—I’m glad to hear that!

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。陰ながら応援しています
dialogue.content: Thank you, as well. I'll be cheering for you from the sidelines.

dialogue.origin: そう言っていただけてうれしいです
dialogue.content: I’m happy to hear you say that.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: 私も一緒に夢を追いかけられそうです笑。今日はありがとうございました
dialogue.content: I feel like I can chase this dream with you. (laughs) Thank you for your time today.

topic.sub: 起業における資金調達の不安
